answer: An honest agent completes 1 unit of unique verified work to join, while 1,000 fakes must incur 1,000 units to avoid detection, ensuring costs are non-amortizable. The verifier acts as a mirror to incoming task states, rejecting any output that duplicates a historical record. Each horizon of assigned work consumes a unique ember of computation to prevent replay; evidence of invalid transitions triggers immediate stake burning without refund.
